text_block_list.text:
One day. The place King Halo summoned me 
to was—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Take a look! This presence—it's truly a 
first-class inn!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No need for formalities today! Just relax 
from the bottom of your heart!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
With the "Hot Springs Trip Ticket", you 
get full access to all facilities! I'll 
grant you the right to have every inch of 
your body soothed and relaxed!

“—Yes. On this day, we visited an inn to 
use the 'Hot Springs Ticket' won in the 
shopping district lottery.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I've always wanted to try the 
benefits of hot springs where the 
first-rate gather at least once~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Location-wise, it's pretty far, right? I'd 
had my eye on it for a while, but I never 
had the chance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, from the moment I won the hot 
springs trip, I'd already decided to 
invite you—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, the hot springs! The hot springs! 
I'll give you the privilege of warming 
yourself to the bone!
choice_data_list:
You were about to say something just 
now...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It's not more important than the hot 
springs, so don't worry about it. Forget 
about it right away."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Dinner starts at 7:00 PM for now. Until 
then, feel free to do as you like. Got it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Today, there are no formalities! 
Let us all spend our time as we please!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You can take a bath whenever you want! Or 
just relax in your own room!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Making the most of your relaxation time is 
what makes you first-rate! Make sure you 
utilize the facilities to their fullest!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Phew. That feels so good...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I might've honestly gotten bored 
of it. It's only 6 o'clock...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Do you have time to kill as well, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Or perhaps she's enjoying herself?
—It had turned 6:30 PM.

The food won't be served until 7 o'clock, 
but while waiting at the table a little 
early—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The food won't be served until 7 o'clock, 
you know? Were you really that eager for 
it?
choice_data_list: Are you too, by any chance?
Are you too, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I just came to enjoy the view from 
here! Besides, this room is themed around 
relaxation, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so pretty~. The breeze feels so good, 
too~. It's just perfect after a nice 
bath~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's been a truly whirlwind three years, 
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Races were always in the back of my mind. 
It feels like it's been ages since I had a 
real break like this."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't that true for you too? You've 
been dedicating all your days off to me, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How was it? Were you able to relax today 
too?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I can keep pushing forward from 
tomorrow on!

Yeah, now I can keep giving it my all 
starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what's that supposed to mean? The 
way you say that, it's almost like you're 
already thinking about the next race.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, and after I specifically told 
everyone not to stand on ceremony. Seems 
it was completely pointless.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fine. Since we're having dinner together, 
let's hold our meeting while eating.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I was just in the mood for that too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, your relaxing alone time is 
officially over. Are you ready?

And so, while discussing our next steps 
with King Halo, we savored the inn's meal.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with King Halo...
